lead: A cursor in inline HTML lands on a node, so "inside no production" is narrower than it looks.
body: `InlineHtml` is one of `nvs_syntax::walk`'s own kinds, and so are `Error` and every operator, so `SyntaxIndex::at` answers something for a cursor almost anywhere in a file. The offsets that are genuinely inside nothing are the trivia runs between two nodes — a blank line between two statements is the one to reach for.
